subject: mathematics_1b
question_text: Find the condition for the points (a,0), (h,k) and (0,b) to be collinear, where ab≠0.

mark_split.label: Write the line through the two axis points

verification.note: Source: Sri Chaitanya, FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students — Mathematics-IB (2026-27 edition), chapter 3 THE STRAIGHT LINE, Very Short Answer question 29, book p.144 (the printed folio is hidden or clipped on this scan; the page is taken from the strictly consecutive neighbours). recall_prompt: Say how you would solve this — say what is special about the first and third points, and which form of the line that gives you.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write the line through the two axis points
steps.margin_note: First mark. (a, 0) sits on the X-axis and (0, b) on the Y-axis, so the intercepts are already given and the intercept form can be written with no work.
steps.memory_tip: An axis point IS an intercept: (a, 0) gives the x-intercept a, (0, b) gives the y-intercept b.
lines: (a, 0) lies on the X-axis and (0, b) lies
So the line through them has x-intercept a

recall.must_convey: That (a, 0) and (0, b) are the axis points, so the line joining them is x/a + y/b = 1.
accept: the first point is on the x axis and the third on the y axis
so a and b are the intercepts
the line is x by a plus y by b equals one
heard_as: x by a plus y by b

steps.why: Two of the three points already name the intercepts, so the line through them needs no two-point formula at all; ab ≠ 0 is exactly what stops either intercept being zero.
common_mistakes: Using the two-point formula on (a, 0) and (0, b) and doing extra work.
Writing x/b + y/a = 1, with a and b swapped.

steps.label: State the condition
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Collinear means the third point is on that same line, so substitute (h, k) into the intercept form and stop.
steps.memory_tip: Collinear with a known line means the remaining point satisfies its equation. Substitute and stop.
lines: The three points are collinear when (h, k)
Clearing the fractions: bh + ak = ab

recall.must_convey: That the condition is h/a + k/b = 1, equivalently bh + ak = ab.
accept: h by a plus k by b equals one
substitute the middle point into the intercept form
b h plus a k equals a b
the third point satisfies the same equation
heard_as: h by a plus k by b

steps.why: Collinearity of three points means all three satisfy one equation; two of them were used to build it, so only the third produces a new statement, and that statement is the condition asked for.
common_mistakes: Writing h/b + k/a = 1, with a and b swapped.
Setting the expression to 0 instead of 1.
